Name: Hair Growth
Author: SknTheLisper
Description:
[size=3]This is a recreation of my previous Aging Mod:[/size]


A simple hair and beard growth mod that changes the hair\beard of the player as time goes on. To cut the hair you can either assign a button(in the config.json file), or use another mod allowing apperance change(the Mirror mod for instance).

[b]Not yet implemented\Planned Feature:[/b]
Optionally progressivly changes the hair to gray\white(depending on if you have light or dark hair) after x-amount of years.


[b][size=4]Installation instructions:[/size][/b][i]
Download then install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] 
Unzip\Create folder named HungerMod in Stadrew Vallley\Mods\
Should look like this:
    Stardew Valley\Mods\HairGrowthMod\  containing these files:
                                                       config.json
             [i]                                         [/i] HairGrowthMod.dll
[i]                                                       [/i]HairGrowthMod.pdb
[i]                                                       [/i]manifest.json

[b][size=4]Update instructions:[/size][/b][i]
Same as installation, if new features are added that can be configured it will be automatically generated to your config file(No need to manually add it) [/i][/i]


[b][size=5]Compatibility:
[/size][/b]Compatible with all mods adding new hair-styles(but you'll have to do some mild-legg work yourself by adding the new hair-styles into the system in the config.json file). As a general rule the hair-id is the hair number at character creation -1.  so say you have hairstyle #23,  the Id is then 22.

[size=5]﻿[b]Configuration:[/b][/size]
[i]  "beard_growth": true, [/i][b]- Whether beard growing system is to be on or not[/b]
[i]  "hair_growth": true,[i] [/i][b]- Whether hair growing system is to be on or not[/b][/i]
[i]  "shave_entire_beard": true,[i] [/i][b]- If false, progressivly reduce beard[/b][/i]
[i]  "allow_female_beard_grow": false,[i] [/i][b]- Make beard grow if you are playing a female character[/b][/i]
[i]  "require_shares": true,[i] [/i][b]- If true, you need to hold shears before you can cut\shave[/b][/i]
[i]  "days_to_grow_hair": 14,[i] [/i][b]- How many days it takes to progress to next hair stage[/b][/i]
[i]  "days_to_grow_beard": 7,[i] [/i][b]- How many days it takesto progress to next beard stage[/b][/i]
[i]  "hair_id_button": "None",[i] [/i][b]- Shows the ID of current hair-style(to make it easier for you to add to the list), change to any key[/b][/i]
[i]  "shave_button": "OemComma",[i] [/i][b]- Key used to shave(need shears with require_shares on true)[/b][/i]
[i]  "cut_hair_button": "OemPeriod",[i] [/i][b]- Key used to cut hair(need shears with require_shares on true)
